text: In Germany you can buy tickets at a counter, at a machine, in an app and online. Tickets bought well in advance are cheaper, but some are valid only for a named train (Zugbindung). A flexible ticket costs more, but you can take any train on that day. A discount card (BahnCard) gives a reduction on long-distance fares.
Seats can be reserved for a small fee. In Austria and Switzerland tickets and rules differ, so check the national railway's website before you go.
